attempts.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Production 2D game sprite animation, full-strip drawing pass. Edit input 1 (transparent eight-slot reference canvas) into ONE HORIZONTAL ROW of EXACTLY EIGHT equally spaced white-paw character cels on a truly transparent background. Input 2 is the locked white-paw seed and sole character/design authority. Input 3 is ONLY a timing/expression example for hurt pain, not a character to copy. The subject is the SAME low crouching cream-and-charcoal long-bodied woodland mustelid with pale muzzle, cream mane/ruff, dark back markings, white paws, long thick cream bushy tail curling upward, sharp small fangs, same LEFT-facing three-quarter view and same painterly non-pixel game style. Preserve every anatomical design and palette, proportions, face structure, fur quality and consistent body scale. Make eight distinct coherent DRAWN cels of one physical hit response: frame 0 exact neutral crouch; 1 initial impact, eyelids halfway closing, shoulder and torso begin a visible backward/downward recoil; 2 both eyes tightly CLOSED in pain, muzzle grimacing, neck tucked and forelegs bend as body weight yields back; 3 peak tightly shut painful eyes, hunched shoulders, strongly readable braced whole-body recoil with the hindlegs supporting the displaced weight and the bushy tail following the body; 4 still closed in pain but beginning to ease out of the braced pose; 5 eyes half-open and forelegs begin extending as chest returns; 6 settling almost to neutral; 7 same exact neutral as frame 0. The peak pain cel will be held for 400ms, so it MUST unmistakably read as injured and bracing, with a changed body silhouette, rather than attack, fear, idle breathing or merely tail motion. Eyes use natural narrow tightly shut eyelids; no X eyes, cartoon stars, impact marks, weapon, blood or additional characters. Same left-facing direction in all eight cels. Each cel must have a complete unclipped entire character with consistent scale and a shared baseline and margin, no touching adjacent slots. ONE row of EIGHT frames only, not two rows, not a poster. Retain empty transparent space above/below if needed. No text, no labels, no grid, no scenery, no shadow rectangle. Preserve the seed design at both endpoints. This is hand-painted full-pose sprite artwork, not a transformed duplicate or a whole-image wobble.
